pertanyaan: The list of items _______ on the desk.
pembahasan: Subjek utamanya "The list" (tunggal), bukan "items" → is.

pertanyaan: Each of the {students} {have} {a} {laptop}.
pembahasan: "Each" selalu tunggal → seharusnya has.

pertanyaan: Neither the manager nor the employees _______ happy with the decision.
pembahasan: Pada neither… nor…, kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat: the employees (jamak) → were.

pertanyaan: Mathematics _______ my favorite subject in high school.
pembahasan: Nama bidang ilmu berakhiran -s (mathematics, physics) dianggap tunggal → was.

pertanyaan: She likes swimming, hiking, and _______.
pembahasan: Unsur dalam daftar harus sejajar: swimming, hiking, running (semua -ing).

pertanyaan: The job {requires} {patience}, {creativity}, and {to be careful}.
pembahasan: Daftar berisi kata benda (patience, creativity) → seharusnya kata benda juga: care.

pertanyaan: The new policy is not only cheaper but also _______.
pembahasan: Not only + adjektiva (cheaper) … but also + adjektiva → more efficient.

pertanyaan: _______ the rain stopped, the game resumed.
pembahasan: Setelah titik-titik ada klausa lengkap (the rain stopped), jadi butuh kata penghubung klausa: As soon as. Despite/during/because of diikuti kata benda.

pertanyaan: Rarely _______ such a beautiful sunset.
pembahasan: Kata negatif di awal kalimat (rarely) memicu inversi: have I seen.

pertanyaan: The book {who} I borrowed {from} the library {is} {overdue}.
pembahasan: "The book" adalah benda → kata ganti relatifnya which/that, bukan who.

pertanyaan: According to the passage, who first documented the urban heat island effect?
pembahasan: Paragraf 1: efek ini pertama kali dicatat oleh Luke Howard, meteorolog amatir.

pertanyaan: What is the primary cause of the urban heat island effect?
opsi_b: Replacing natural land cover with asphalt, concrete, and brick
opsi_c: A lack of rain in city centers
opsi_d: Tall buildings that block the wind
pembahasan: Paragraf 2: "The primary cause… is the replacement of natural land cover with materials such as asphalt, concrete, and brick".

pertanyaan: What is the passage mainly about?
opsi_c: The causes, effects, and possible solutions of urban heat islands
pembahasan: Passage membahas penyebab (paragraf 2), dampak (paragraf 3), dan solusi (paragraf 4) → C.

pertanyaan: The word "mitigate" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
pembahasan: "Mitigate" = mengurangi/meredakan → reduce. Kalimat berikutnya memberi contoh cara mengurangi efek panas.

pertanyaan: The word "it" in paragraph 4 refers to
pembahasan: "…reflect sunlight rather than absorb it" → it = sunlight.

pertanyaan: Why is the temperature difference between cities and the countryside often greatest at night?
opsi_a: Cars are used more at night
opsi_d: City surfaces release the heat they stored during the day
pembahasan: Paragraf 2: permukaan kota menyerap panas siang hari lalu melepaskannya pelan-pelan setelah matahari terbenam.

pertanyaan: What does the man mean?
opsi_b: He did not finish the report.
opsi_c: He wrote the report in the library.
opsi_d: He does not have a lab report.
pembahasan: "I wish I had. I fell asleep at my desk." → ia belum menyelesaikan laporannya.

pertanyaan: What does the woman suggest the man do?
pembahasan: "Why don't you ask Dr. Patel during her office hours?" = saran untuk minta bantuan dosen.

pertanyaan: What does the man mean?
opsi_a: He did not take the exam.
opsi_b: He thinks the exam was easy.
opsi_c: He agrees that the exam was difficult.
opsi_d: He wants the woman to repeat herself.
pembahasan: Ungkapan "You can say that again" = sangat setuju, bukan meminta mengulang.

pertanyaan: The number of registered hives in London more than doubled between 2008 and 2013.
pembahasan: Paragraf A: "the number of registered hives more than doubled between 2008 and 2013" → TRUE.

pertanyaan: Bees in cities are exposed to more pesticides than bees in the countryside.
pembahasan: Paragraf B: kota justru "largely free of the agricultural pesticides" → FALSE.

pertanyaan: Beekeeping is now more popular in Paris than in London.
pembahasan: Paris hanya disebut mengalami pertumbuhan serupa; tidak ada perbandingan dengan London → NOT GIVEN.

pertanyaan: What do conservation groups now recommend city residents do?
pembahasan: Paragraf D: "plant bee-friendly flowers rather than install new hives".

pertanyaan: A 2020 study found that the amount of available _______ had not kept pace with the number of colonies.
pembahasan: Paragraf C: "the amount of available forage had not kept pace…".

pertanyaan: Caller's surname: _______
pembahasan: Penelepon mengeja namanya: H-A-R-T-L-E-Y → Hartley.

pertanyaan: The course starts on the _______ of March.
pembahasan: "The course starts on the fourteenth of March". Semua penulisan tanggal diterima.
instruksi: Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.

pertanyaan: Course fee for members: £_______
pembahasan: Harga normal £95, tetapi untuk anggota "reduced to seventy" → 70. Hati-hati pengecoh 95.

pertanyaan: Classes are held in the _______ Room, on the first floor.
pembahasan: "In the Garden Room, on the first floor, next to the café."
